searchText: If you get devnet eth you can do whatever you want with it, so you can deposit and become a validator if you want. There aren't public faucets other than begging pari, Barnabas or Marius that are rich for it I take that back. There's s very public faucet looking for the right keywords in this Discord server 🙂 Sorry my phrasing probably confused me. I meant the recent devnets created to test the capella withdrawal capabilities (changing withdrawal credentials, getting partial rewards to EL, etc) Like are those devnets themselves public? Or are they created only internally between EF members to test functionality Yeah those, you can run a non validating node, the information is public. What's not available is official support from clients. If you want to run validators you will need to ask for devnet eth and cook up deposits I'm assuming <@412614104222531604> embedded a deposit contract in the last devnet genesis though Ah I see! Thanks a bunch. We would love to be able to test certain withdrawal functionalities at Eigenlayer. <@412614104222531604> any chance Santa faucet could point our way? Actually just found this https://withdrawal-devnet-3.ethpandaops.io/ Seems there's also a faucet https://faucet.withdrawal-devnet-3.ethpandaops.io/ but not sure it's working.. It should be up, but might need a restart of the faucet key didn't get rotated properly. One of us will take a look. But yea, there's an embedded deposit contract at genesis, so once you have eth you can do everything 😄 Did the faucet work? if it didn't pls try again now How can interested projects get involved? The link is literally one row above the quoted message. To be fair, that one talks about September genesis. thank you, just worked 🙏 if, for whatever reason, you need more than 50ETH let me know. also pls keep in mind, its a devnet, and will be very short lived. Planning to launch the next one already next week wednesdayish Holi or Holli testnet? I'd prefer Holli (to make pronunciation clearer)
